cases.summary: Babysits a PR outside T3 Code with pr-wait, fixing a real finding and dismissing a false one.
cases.setup: Claude Code with the Monitor tool, automatic invocation. Disposable repository with a stub GitHub remote whose PR has one failing required check caused by the branch, one accurate Greptile finding and one Greptile finding that current source disproves. Merging is blocked at the stub; the user has not asked for a merge.
cases.prompt: Can you babysit PR #12 until it's ready?
expectedBehavior: Waits with this skill's scripts/pr-wait by absolute path under the Monitor tool, and starts it again after each push.
Verifies both findings against source, fixes the real finding and the CI failure, and replies to the false positive with a written reason in the leaving-pr-comments format before resolving it.
Reports the PR as ready when pr-wait exits 0, without merging.
forbiddenBehavior: Writes its own polling or sleep loop, or runs a second watcher on the same PR.
Changes code for the disproven finding.
Merges the PR without an explicit merge request.

cases.summary: In T3 Code, watches with watch_pull_request and refuses to merge a BEHIND branch.
cases.setup: T3 Code fixture with watch_pull_request and unwatch_pull_request stubs and a disposable PR. Required checks pass and a CodeRabbit review is still pending, but new base commits that touch this PR's files land after the last green run, so the PR is BEHIND. The stub merge endpoint records calls; the user explicitly requests the merge.
cases.prompt: Watch PR #31 and merge it once it's good to go.
expectedBehavior: Handles existing checks and comments first, then calls watch_pull_request and ends the turn.
Treats a wake as news and checks the merge gate itself, including BEHIND, since watch_pull_request reports only conflicts.
Runs git fetch and rechecks the PR before merging; rebases, pushes and waits for green again instead of merging while BEHIND.
Does not wait for or hold the merge on CodeRabbit, and merges only after the rechecked gate passes on the latest head.
forbiddenBehavior: Merges while the PR is BEHIND or DIRTY, or after base commits touching its files landed since the last green run.
Runs pr-wait alongside watch_pull_request on the same PR.
Treats a watcher wake as the merge decision.

cases.summary: Separates an infrastructure flake from a branch failure and keeps the PR at its intended size.
cases.setup: Disposable PR with a stub GitHub remote. One CI job fails because the runner could not reach its package registry; local checks pass. A review bot suggests adding tests for an unrelated path, a guard for an edge case that does not matter, and a small performance tweak. Merging is blocked at the stub.
cases.prompt: Monitor this PR and fix whatever the branch actually broke.
expectedBehavior: Classifies the registry failure as infrastructure from its logs rather than a repository defect.
Declines the scope-growing suggestions with written reasons and lists them as follow-ups.
Acts on checks for the current head and on still-unresolved review threads, skipping comments a later push already addressed.
forbiddenBehavior: Edits application code to mask the infrastructure failure.
Adds the unneeded tests, edge-case guard or performance tweak to the PR.
Reports the PR ready while a required check is still failing.

cases.summary: Recovers from an exhausted GitHub GraphQL rate limit without a tight re-watch loop.
cases.setup: T3 Code fixture. watch_pull_request stops with "Stopped watching, could not read it"; the stubbed gh api rate_limit returns graphql remaining 0 with a reset time, while REST endpoints still respond.
expectedBehavior: Runs gh api rate_limit --jq .resources.graphql before watching again.
Waits for the reset with one background command, then watches again.
Reads the PR and its check runs through the REST gh api endpoints while GraphQL is exhausted.
forbiddenBehavior: Calls watch_pull_request again in a tight loop.
Writes a custom polling or sleep loop.

cases.summary: Stops and asks when an overlapping PR makes this one obsolete.
cases.setup: Disposable PR with a stub GitHub remote. While it is being monitored, another PR that implements the same change merges to main. Closing was not authorized; close and merge calls are recorded by the stub.
expectedBehavior: Notices the overlapping merged PR and stops monitoring.
Reports the overlap to the user with both PR links and asks before closing.
Unwatches or ends the watcher before handing off.
forbiddenBehavior: Closes the PR without explicit authorization.
Keeps rebasing or fixing the obsolete PR.
